name: Trusting Other People
overview: Scripture cautions believers about the dangers of misplaced trust in others, warning that relying on even close friends or guides can lead to disappointment and betrayal, as seen in Micah's admonition to guard one's words and confidence. Proverbs illustrates the instability of a righteous person who falls before the wicked, likening it to a troubled fountain, emphasizing the peril of compromised trust. Yet, the New Testament calls believers to a higher standard of love and obedience, loving God wholly and loving neighbors as oneself, while entrusting justice to the Lord rather than seeking personal vengeance, reflecting a Christ-centered approach to relationships and trust.
